## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it addresses.

## Validation

- [ ] Offline host tests pass (`bash tests/run_host_tests.sh`).
- [ ] Android debug build passes, or the reason it was not run is stated.
- [ ] Changes to hashing/serialization/job allocation have independent regression coverage.
- [ ] Device/runtime tests performed are listed, without implying untested coverage.
- [ ] No keys, credentials or identifying wallet data are included.
- [ ] Documentation/changelog updated where relevant.

## Device / screenshots (if applicable)

Redact personal information. Distinguish real pool data from offline test results.
